home.title: Calming exercises and self-assessment questionnaires
home.description: Community-built tools for anxiety relief including breathing techniques, grounding, and muscle relaxation.

breathing.title: 2-Minute Breathing Exercise
breathing.description: Free guided breathing exercise using a 4:6 rhythm, to slow down and settle when anxiety rises.

grounding.title: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding Technique
grounding.description: Free grounding exercise using your 5 senses to come back to the present moment when anxiety or panic rises.

guidedBreathing.title: Guided Breathing Exercise
guidedBreathing.description: Extended guided breathing exercises with gentle guidance. 5-10 minute sessions for deeper relaxation and anxiety management.

progressiveMuscleRelaxation.title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
progressiveMuscleRelaxation.description: Free guided muscle relaxation exercise. Release physical tension and anxiety through systematic muscle relaxation techniques.

peacefulVisualization.title: Peaceful Visualization
peacefulVisualization.description: Guided visualization exercises for anxiety relief. Journey to calming places in your mind for stress reduction and relaxation.

thoughtLabeling.title: Thought Labeling
thoughtLabeling.description: Interactive anxiety thought categorization tool. Identify and label anxious thoughts to reduce their emotional impact.

stressReliefBubbles.title: Stress Relief Bubbles - Interactive Game
stressReliefBubbles.description: Interactive bubble popping game for stress relief and anxiety management. Satisfying sensory experience for tension release.

fidgetSpinner.title: Online Fidget Spinner - Calming Motion for Restless Energy
fidgetSpinner.description: Minimal virtual fidget spinner with realistic momentum. Drag to spin, release to settle, and give restless hands a steady outlet.

soundTherapy.title: Sound Therapy - Soothing Sounds and Frequencies
soundTherapy.description: Free sound therapy: sounds, frequencies and binaural beats to relax and ease stress.

stressBall.title: Interactive Stress Ball - Release Tension
stressBall.description: Virtual stress ball: drag, throw and bounce the ball to release tension. Free.

privacy.title: Privacy and personal data
privacy.description: No account, no cookies, no analytics: what Ma boussole bien-être does (and does not do) with your data, in line with the GDPR.

terms.title: Legal notice and terms of use
terms.description: Publisher, host, medical disclaimer and open-source licence of Ma boussole bien-être.

support.title: Help and contact
support.description: FAQ and contact for Ma boussole bien-être, a free site with no sign-up.

mobile.title: Mobile Apps
mobile.description: Download Ma boussole bien-être mobile app for iOS and Android. Free anxiety relief techniques on the go - breathing exercises, grounding, and more.

worryTime.title: Worry Time - Postpone Your Worries
worryTime.description: Free tool to write down your worries and set them an appointment at a chosen time of day. Nothing is saved.

leavesOnStream.title: Leaves on a Stream - Gaining Distance from Thoughts
leavesOnStream.description: Free defusion exercise (ACT): place your thoughts on leaves and watch them drift away. Nothing is saved.

selfCompassion.title: Self-Compassion Break - Speaking to Yourself Kindly
selfCompassion.description: A guided three-step break to get through a difficult moment with more kindness towards yourself.

thoughtRecord.title: Questioning a Thought - Guided CBT Worksheet
thoughtRecord.description: Free guided worksheet to examine an anxious thought: situation, emotions, thinking traps, facts, balanced thought. PDF export, nothing is saved.
